text.name: vtpas_slip_label
text.text: Wheel slip for rear diff lock

text.name: vtpas_slip_tip
text.text: Wheel slip (%) above which the rear differential locks automatically (Enhanced Vehicle). It unlocks at half this threshold. Off = never.

text.name: vtpas_slipFront_label
text.text: Wheel slip for front diff lock

text.name: vtpas_slipFront_tip
text.text: Wheel slip (%) above which the front differential locks automatically (Enhanced Vehicle). It unlocks at half this threshold. Off = never.

text.name: vtpas_diff_tip
text.text: Auto = AutoSwitch locks the differentials on slip, picks 2WD / 4WD and releases the locks in turns. Manual = you handle everything; an engaged lock is never released, the tractor only turns up to its limit (wheels turned fully, it slides) (50 % rear, 20 % front, 10 % both). Key: Right Ctrl + Up arrow.

text.name: vtpas_tire_tip
text.text: With AutoDrive or Courseplay inflating and deflating are always automatic. This setting applies when you drive yourself: Automatic = inflated on roads, deflated in fields; Manual = you use the mod's key.

text.name: vtpas_notifDiff_tip
text.text: Shows a notification when a vehicle locks or unlocks its differentials.

text.name: vtpas_notifTires_tip
text.text: Shows a notification when a vehicle inflates or deflates its tires.

text.name: vtpas_alert_pct_tip
text.text: Shows a red message when a vehicle's wheel slip stays above this percentage for the set duration. Off = no alert.

text.name: vtpas_alert_sec_tip
text.text: Time (in seconds) the slip must stay above the threshold before the alert appears.

text.name: vtpas_alert_slip
text.text: %s: excessive wheel slip (%.0f%%) for more than %d s!

text.name: vtpas_diffdelay_tip
text.text: Time (in seconds) the wheel slip must stay above the threshold before the differentials lock automatically.

text.name: vtpas_tiredelay_tip
text.text: Minimum time (in seconds) between two pressure changes (inflate / deflate) to avoid rapid back-and-forth. Off = no delay.

text.name: vtpas_hintShow_tip
text.text: Shows the recommended speed range above the speedometer, updated continuously from the zone (field / road), tire pressure, soil type, soil moisture and wheel slip.

text.name: vtpas_hint_risk
text.text: Risk of getting stuck: min %d km/h, don't stop

text.name: vtpas_dur_tip
text.text: How long (in seconds) the message stays on screen.

text.name: vtpas_protectSeed_tip
text.text: Prevents Mud System Physics from erasing crops under the wheels when the vehicle reverses, and under the wheels of a seeder or planter. Other mud crop damage is kept.

text.name: vtpas_slipIcon_tip
text.text: Always shows (in a vehicle) the tractor seen from above (locked axles in red, 4WD driveline in green) with the slip of each wheel, or a single percentage per locked axle, movable with the mouse independently of the speed range. Colour: white, yellow from 10 %, orange at the differential threshold, red at the alert threshold.

text.name: vtpas_seedCoverFill_tip
text.text: Allows seeders and planters to be filled with seeds (big bag, pallet, trailer, auger, station) even when the hopper cover is closed. Off = base game behaviour.

text.name: vtpas_wetGrip_tip
text.text: MoreRealistic ignores the grip computed by Mud System Physics and Tractor Terrain Dynamics. This setting reduces wheel grip in fields depending on local moisture (from 20 %, maximum at 70 %) and soil type, and lowers MoreRealistic's 'wet field' grip by 20 %. At 60 % moisture: about -34 % (Beginner), -45 % (Easy), -56 % (Normal), -67 % (Hard), -78 % (Extreme).

text.name: vtpas_auto4wd_label
text.text: Drive: 2WD on asphalt and concrete, 4WD elsewhere

text.name: vtpas_auto4wd_tip
text.text: Automatically switches to two-wheel drive on hard surfaces (asphalt road, concrete) and to four-wheel drive everywhere else: fields, gravel or dirt tracks, grass (Enhanced Vehicle). In 2WD, if the rear axle slips beyond the threshold, 4WD engages first, then the differentials lock if slip continues; on the road it returns to 2WD once grip is back. A manual change is kept until the next ground change.

text.name: vtpas_autoOnHelper_label
text.text: Back to Auto with AutoDrive / Courseplay

text.name: vtpas_autoOnHelper_tip
text.text: In Manual, switches back to Auto as soon as AutoDrive or Courseplay takes over the tractor.

text.name: as_dual_store_function
text.text: On foot next to the rack, with a stopped tractor nearby: Right Ctrl + I. Full rack = mount dual wheels, empty rack = remove them. 30 min of work (15 min per tire), one tire every 15 min.

text.name: as_dual_mounting
text.text: Dual wheel mounting started: ready at %s

text.name: as_dual_unmounting
text.text: Dual wheel removal started: ready at %s

text.name: as_dual_none
text.text: No dual wheels available for this tractor

text.name: as_dual_stop
text.text: Stop the tractor to change wheels

text.name: as_dual_mp
text.text: Wheel change is only available in single player

text.name: as_dual_notractor
text.text: No tractor parked near the tire rack

text.name: as_dual_alreadytwin
text.text: This tractor already has dual wheels: the rack only provides dual wheels

text.name: as_dual_running
text.text: Wheel change already in progress: ready at %s

text.name: as_dual_rackempty
text.text:
This rack is empty (or incomplete).
Its tires are mounted on another tractor: remove them from that tractor first, or use a full rack.

text.name: as_dual_rackfull
text.text:
This rack is not empty: it cannot take the removed tires.
Use an empty rack.

text.name: as_dual_rackbusy
text.text: This rack is already used for another wheel change in progress.

text.name: as_dual_store_function_ar
text.text: 2 BKT Agrimax V-Flecto 650/65R42 tires on rims. On foot next to the rack with a stopped tractor nearby: Right Ctrl + I. Alone = rear dual wheels; with the front rack = front + rear dual wheels. 30 min of work (15 min per tire).

text.name: as_dual_store_function_av
text.text: 2 BKT Agrimax V-Flecto 540/65R30 tires on rims. Use it with the rear rack to mount front + rear dual wheels (Right Ctrl + I, on foot next to the racks).

text.name: as_dual_needar
text.text:
No full rear dual wheel rack near this tractor.
An empty rack means its tires are already mounted on another tractor: remove them from that tractor first, or buy a new rack.

text.name: as_dual_needav
text.text:
This tractor only exists with front + rear dual wheels.
Add a full front dual wheel rack near the tractor.

text.name: as_dual_needar_empty
text.text:
To remove the dual wheels, an empty rear rack is needed near the tractor to put the tires on.
A full rack cannot take more tires.

text.name: as_dual_needav_empty
text.text: This tractor also has front dual wheels: an empty front rack is also needed near the tractor.

text.name: as_dual_confirm_on
text.text:
Mounting dual wheels: %d tires, %d min of work (ready around %s).
The tractor will be immobilized during the change: you cannot enter it or start a helper. If it is moved, the change is cancelled.
Start mounting?

text.name: as_dual_confirm_off
text.text:
Removing dual wheels: %d tires, %d min of work (ready around %s).
The tractor will be immobilized during the change: you cannot enter it or start a helper. If it is moved, the change is cancelled.
Start removal?

text.name: as_dual_brand
text.text: No %s dual wheels for this tractor: change the tire brand in the workshop (available: %s)

text.name: as_dual_locked
text.text: Tractor immobilized: wheel change in progress (ready at %s)

text.name: as_dual_zone
text.text: Park the tractor inside the mounting area (rectangle on the ground next to the rack)

text.name: vtpas_adField_tip
text.text: Speed imposed on AutoDrive in a field, instead of its own setting. AutoDrive still slows down in turns and on arrival.

text.name: vtpas_adPath_tip
text.text: Speed imposed on AutoDrive on tracks (gravel, dirt, grass).

text.name: vtpas_adRoad_tip
text.text: Speed imposed on AutoDrive on paved roads. No limit: the tractor's maximum speed.

text.name: vtpas_sleepText
text.text: Choose how long to sleep: hours and days.

text.name: vtpas_windSway_tip
text.text: How strongly trees, crops and grass move in the wind. x1 = base game (at 57 km/h the base game only moves foliage like a breeze). The wind speed itself is unchanged.

text.name: vtpas_hudDedup_tip
text.text: Hides info other mods repeat (e.g. Enhanced Vehicle: Wear | Paint and Fuel). Those mods' settings are not changed.

text.name: vtpas_overdraft_tip
text.text: Buying and leasing allowed with a negative balance, down to this percentage of the resale value of what you own (purchased equipment, land, buildings). Off = base game.

text.name: vtpas_overdraftRate_tip
text.text: Interest charged every in-game day on the negative balance, prorated over the year (12 months). "Overdraft interest" line in Finances.

text.name: vtpas_coopPay_label
text.text: Co-ops pay at the end of the month

text.name: vtpas_coopPay_tip
text.text: Sales to co-ops (selling points whose name contains "coop") are marked "To be paid" in the register (Right Ctrl + R) and paid at the end of the month, "Co-ops" line in Finances. Editable list: modSettings/FS25_AutoSwitch/cooperatives.xml.

text.name: vtpas_hours_tip
text.text: Shop and selling points closed outside their opening hours. Exceptions per selling point: modSettings/FS25_AutoSwitch/horaires.xml (open="0" close="24": open 24/7).

text.name: vtpas_hours_shop_tip
text.text: Outside opening hours the shop can be browsed but buying, leasing, selling or building is refused.

text.name: vtpas_hours_sell_tip
text.text: Silos, mills, factories... Outside opening hours nothing is accepted; an AutoDrive truck waits until opening.

text.name: vtpas_hours_shopClosed
text.text: The shop is closed. Open from %s to %s.

text.name: vtpas_noOvertake_tip
text.text: Traffic cars stay behind tractors (AutoDrive or driven) on the road. They may pass when the tractor has been stopped for 10 s or has its hazard lights on.

text.name: vtpas_shopBlockTwins_tip
text.text: The shop and workshop no longer offer dual wheels: fit them with the tire pallets. Tractors already on duals keep them, and a pallet can switch them back to single wheels.

text.name: vtpas_weatherWidget_label
text.text: Mini weather next to the clock

text.name: vtpas_weatherWidget_tip
text.text: Shows the current weather and the next change left of the clock. Drag it with the mouse when the cursor is visible; a click opens the Weather window (Right Ctrl + M).

text.name: input_AS_REGISTER
text.text: Weighings and sales register: open / close

text.name: vtpas_wx_footer
text.text: Game forecast for the next %s. Amounts estimated from intensity. * = day not fully forecast

text.name: vtpas_beamRange_tip
text.text: Distance lit by the headlights and work lights of all vehicles, yours included. x1 = base game. Costs some FPS at night.

text.name: vtpas_beamGlow_tip
text.text: Strength of the ground lighting from the headlights and work lights of all vehicles, yours included. x1 = base game.

text.name: vtpas_beamEnabled_tip
text.text: Yes: headlight reach and brightness set below. No: base game headlights, no processing (better performance).

text.name: vtpas_tracksMax_tip
text.text: Number of tire track points kept and saved with the game. Fewer = less memory and processing.
